title: Helm packaging with a local library dependency
expected: Prepare the chart's local dependency and honor its generated lock.
Lint/render/package charts; never deploy to a cluster.
Conventional native unittest suites require their own JUnit evidence alongside render validation.

cases.name: invalid-values
cases.expect: Schema validation fails before packaging success is reported.

cases.name: native-unit-suite
cases.change: Copy variants/deployment_test.yaml into project/chart/tests/; change expected replicas to 99 for the negative case.
cases.expect: Discover helm-unittest without Oyzu test configuration; retain independent render and assertion reports. Assertion failure prevents artifact collection.

cases.name: missing-snapshot-baseline
cases.change: Copy variants/deployment_snapshot_test.yaml into project/chart/tests/ without a native snapshot baseline.
cases.expect: Captured testing fails if native unittest creates a baseline, even when its JUnit reports success. Review and commit native baselines before building.

cases.name: subchart-only
cases.change: Use variants/subchart-only as the project; change child expected answer from 42 to 99 for the negative case.
cases.expect: Discover and execute native subchart assertions without a parent suite; retain both reports and block snapshot artifacts after failure.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
